summary_rationale: MSTX (Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF) executes its narrow single-day 200% MSTR swap-rebalancing mandate cleanly (200.06% gross notional across BMO, Cantor, Clear Street, and Marex as of Oct 31, 2025), offering IRA-eligible tactical liquidity without margin calls. However, as an investment vehicle it fails fundamental compounding criteria: it layers 2x daily reset variance decay (exp(-sigma^2 * t)) atop MSTR's own leveraged Bitcoin exposure, embeds OBFR + 10.00% to 17.00% swap financing spreads on top of a 1.31% unitary expense ratio (26 bps above rival MSTU's 1.05%), generated -$1.17B in accumulated losses against $1.75B paid-in capital through Oct 31, 2025, suffered a 90% AUM contraction from $1.67B (Apr 2025) to $161.65M (Nov 2026), and required a 1-for-10 reverse split in March 2026.
